name: redstone-ore-touch
comment: Redstone ore (73) set into the stone platform at (2, 60, 2) and (-2, 60, 2); a layer of glowing redstone ore (74) under the platform (y = 59, -8..8). A standing player right-clicks the first ore at t = 1 (BlockRedstoneOre.blockActivated: sparkle, six times three World.rand floats, and it turns into 74; returns false, so use_item goes on to the empty hand) and again at t = 5 (already glowing: sparkle only). The glowing ore's random ticks (tickOnLoad, with the player present) turn it back into 73, and its randomDisplayTick sparkles with World.rand draws inside randomDisplayUpdates: rng_state every tick pins both. An item falls onto the second ore at t = 0: EntityItem.canTriggerWalking is false (EntityItem.java:23), so onEntityWalking never runs and that ore stays 73. Not covered: onEntityWalking itself (needs a walking living entity, WP-2) and onBlockClicked (no left-click op).
